login.title: Cargo
login.subtitle: Sign in with Discord to send a file in seconds.
login.privacy: No new account to make. No history kept. Once it's done, it's gone.

send.title: Send
send.subtitle: Pick a Discord friend. Drop your file. Share the one-hour link.
send.recipientPendingNote: Not on Cargo yet? The one-hour window starts now — it's on them to sign in in time to grab the file.
send.privacy: Cargo never tracks who sent what to whom. No logs. No list. Nothing.
send.dropzoneTitle: Drop a file here, or click to choose one
send.dropzoneHint: Up to 200 GB. Pause and resume any time.
send.pendingWaitingFor: Waiting on @{handle}. The one-hour window is already running — it's on them to sign in in time.
send.pendingExpiresHint: If they don't sign in by {date}, the file is deleted for good.
send.linkPrivacy: After it expires, the file is gone for good. Cargo keeps no history.

outbox.title: Sent
outbox.subtitle: Files you've sent that are still active.
outbox.empty: Nothing here. Cargo doesn't keep a history — finished transfers don't stick around.
outbox.revokeBody: This will stop any download in progress and erase the file. Type the file name to confirm:
outbox.editRecipientBody: Send this file to a different Discord friend instead. The one-hour countdown keeps going.
outbox.editRecipientInvalid: That doesn't look like a Discord username.
outbox.editRecipientFailed: Couldn't change the recipient. Try again.
outbox.pending: Waiting for them to sign in
outbox.pendingUntil: Disappears on {date} if not picked up
outbox.purgeAllBody: This will stop every download in progress and erase all {count} of your active files. Type "{word}" to confirm:

inbox.title: Received
inbox.subtitle: Files sent to you that are still here.
inbox.empty: Nothing here yet. New files land here and stick around for an hour.
inbox.welcomeBody: {count, plural, =1 {1 file is waiting for you. Its one-hour window is already running — grab it before it's gone.} other {# files are waiting for you. Their one-hour windows are already running — grab them before they're gone.}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Preferences and your account.
settings.storageBody: Active transfers count toward your storage limit. Space frees up automatically when a transfer finishes, expires, or is cancelled.
settings.storageResetBody: This will stop every download in progress and erase all your active files. Type "{word}" to confirm:
settings.privacyBody: Cargo only keeps what's needed to send the file, then erases everything when the transfer ends. No logs. No activity list. No history.
settings.exportBody: Get a zip with your profile and any active transfers. There's nothing else to download — that's the whole idea.
settings.deleteBody: Removes your account, erases the files you've sent, and unlinks your name from files sent to you. This can't be undone.

landing.gone: This file is gone. Once a transfer ends, Cargo keeps nothing about it.
landing.signInPrompt: Sign in to download this file.

home.metaTitle: Cargo — send a file, then it's gone
home.metaDescription: Free file transfers that disappear. One friend, one hour, then gone for good. No accounts to make. No history kept.
home.subhead: Free, private, and gone in an hour. Sign in with Discord and send up to 200 GB.
home.step1Body: Type their Discord username. Only that person will be able to download the file.
home.step2Body: Up to 200 GB. Pause and resume any time. Locked with a key only Cargo holds.
home.step3Body: They have one hour to download it. Then it's gone for good.
home.privacyHeading: Carries your file. Never remembers it.
home.privacyIntro: Free to use. Built to move files, not to remember them. We keep only what the transfer needs — and drop it the moment it's done.
home.privacyFact1Body: Each file gets its own key. No one — not even us — can read it on the way.
home.privacyFact2Body: Only the friend you named can download the file. No one else, ever.
home.privacyFact3Body: The clock starts the moment the file is ready. No extending it, no resending.
home.privacyFact4Body: No logs. No activity list. No record of where you came from.
home.privacyEmphasis: There's no history page because there's no history.

download.expiryNote: After it expires, the file is gone for good. Cargo keeps no history.
download.thanks: All done. Cargo forgets the rest.
download.started: Your download has started. If your browser missed it, try again.
download.shareCta: Send a file too — free, up to 200 GB

errors.not_recipient: This file wasn't sent to you.
errors.not_sender: Only the person who sent it can do that.
errors.quota_exceeded: That would put you over your 200 GB storage limit.
errors.rate_limited: Whoa — give it a second and try again.
errors.decrypt_failed: The file got damaged in transit. Ask the sender to send it again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our end. Try again.

notFound.title: Nothing here.
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist — or the transfer it pointed to is already gone. Cargo keeps no history, so once a link expires there's nothing left to find.

errorPage.title: Something broke.
errorPage.body: Something went wrong on our end. Nothing you sent was kept. Try again — and if it keeps happening, give it a minute.
